comparison.objective: Commission a robot-axis damper vs close a cabinet door while avoiding a hot zone.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-tool manipulation and iterative adjustment vs constrained-path door pushing around a forbidden volume.
comparison.success_condition: Repeated non-bottoming stops and retained setting vs closed-door angle held one second with no arm entering the hot zone.
comparison.reason: The record tests collision-free articulated closure, not adjustment or dynamic-response calibration.
